name: Galleonaire
description:
Galleonaire is an independent, fan-made Harry Potter knowledge quiz for iPhone and Apple Watch. Play a fifteen-question Classic ladder for a fictional million-galleon prize, or take a subject exam across the books, films and wider wizarding world.

The collection includes the original 1,000 questions and 264 additional specialist questions. Ten subjects each offer a 20-question, untimed O.W.L. and a 50-question N.E.W.T. with standard, extended or untimed options. Exam answers can be changed or revisited and are saved immediately; marks, full grades and explanations appear after submission. A timed exam continues while the app is closed or the Watch sleeps. New attempts are randomised, while resumed attempts keep their original questions and order.

Redesigned Statistics separates Classic records, topic performance and exam results. Earlier records are retained, with ambiguous old topics shown separately. Native controls, readable text, VoiceOver labels and independently adjustable music, effects and haptics support accessible play. Both platforms work independently offline; exam records remain on the device where they were created.

Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced.

Existing testers can install through TestFlight. The existing Community Beta invitation remains https://testflight.apple.com/join/52fmzweP. Requires iOS 17 or later and watchOS 10 or later.
whatToTest:
EXAM MODE AND REDESIGNED STATISTICS

Exam Mode is available from the main menu on iPhone and Apple Watch. Choose a qualification and subject, read the briefing, then activate Begin Exam. All ten subjects offer both qualifications. Series-wide spoilers apply.

O.W.L.: 20 intermediate questions, untimed.
N.E.W.T.: 50 expert questions, with 25 minutes, 37 minutes 30 seconds, or no time limit. The timer continues while the app is closed or the Watch sleeps. Saved answers are submitted once at expiry; unanswered questions score zero.

Answer, skip, revisit and change choices before submitting. Feedback stays neutral until submission. Resume Exam identifies the saved paper and progress. Results show exact marks, percentage, full grade and pass/fail, with a separate explanation review. Retakes draw and shuffle again; saved attempts keep their original questions and answer order.

Statistics now groups Classic accuracy, games, prizes and streaks, with lifeline and level details behind a labelled control. Ten reviewed topics replace scattered labels; earlier ambiguous topic records remain included in overall accuracy. Exam results are separate, with best results and individual attempts.

264 new specialist questions extend the general pool. Existing question IDs, Classic prize levels and saved records remain intact. New questions include exceptionally obscure book details, Rowling's extended lore and film production facts, with sources and duplication review.

Feedback on question accuracy, difficulty, readability or accessibility is welcome through TestFlight. Each device keeps its own exam progress and results.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Choose New Game for Classic or Exam Mode for the new qualifications. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and plays independently. Timed exams continue against a saved deadline while closed; extended and untimed alternatives are available. Answers and explanations are revealed after submission. Galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. The independently written question bank retains source notes and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
